# toc-extraction: bo leaderboard

Headline metric: `structure_f1` (see [TASK.md](../../TASK.md)). Higher is better. Rows are only ranked against rows on the same data version and model ([VERSIONING.md](../../../../VERSIONING.md)). Values are the mean ± standard deviation over the run's repeats. Live site: https://buddhistai.github.io/buddhist-benchmarks/

Best skill (installed from buddhist-skills): [`toc-extraction` skill](https://github.com/BuddhistAI/buddhist-skills/tree/main/skills/toc-extraction-tibetan) 1.0.0 (variant sabcad-outliner-toc), promoted 2026-11-13. Full report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/BuddhistAI/toc-extraction-tibetan/blob/main/REPORT.md).

- TOC extraction (sa-bcad method) and TOC extraction (GEPA-optimized) are a near-tie: the gap in the mean of both models is within run-to-run noise, and the GEPA-optimized skill does better on the held-out book. Re-run both after the held-out references are fixed (benchmark toc-extraction/bo 2.0.1).
- sabcad-outliner and sabcad-outliner+script are a .docx outliner skill run through a benchmark adapter. They can't ship as a TOC skill as they are; TOC extraction (sa-bcad method) is the shippable form.

## Benchmark toc-extraction/bo 2.0.0

Data set [`tasks/toc-extraction/data/bo/v2/`](https://github.com/BuddhistAI/buddhist-benchmarks/tree/toc-extraction/bo%402.0.0/tasks/toc-extraction/data/bo/v2) at tag `toc-extraction/bo@2.0.0`: 85 items; 76 same book, 9 held out book; scorer 2.0.0. Find the sa-bcad outline headings in passages of Tibetan commentary whose formatting and line breaks were stripped, with their nesting level and start position.

- **Best overall:** TOC extraction (sa-bcad method) 1.0.0 on Claude Sonnet 5.5: 0.962, ≈$1.20 per 100 pages.
- **Best value:** TOC extraction (GEPA-optimized) 1.0.0 on Claude Haiku 5.5: 0.824, ≈$0.050 per 100 pages, 24× cheaper than best overall.

Cost is the API bill to run the skill on 100 pages of text (a page = 1,500 characters of input), at list prices from https://www.anthropic.com/pricing as of 2026-11-03: Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.1 in / $0.5 out per million tokens; Claude Sonnet 5.5 $2 in / $10 out per million tokens. No prompt caching or batch discount. ≈ marks estimates: these runs did not log tokens, so tokens were counted from the exact prompts and stored outputs. Best value is the top score among options costing at most 20% of the best overall.

- **All:** All 85 passages, 394 headings.
